tickets.title: Prepare updated funds-flow schedule for business sale closing
tickets.text: Prepare an updated funds-flow schedule separating gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees for Julian Maplesprocket's sale of his 78% interest in Buttonwood Balloon Components to Copper Firefly Systems. Reconcile the $20.6 million gross share against the $2.2 million escrow holdback and $1.5 million preferred-equity rollover to confirm the expected $16.9 million closing cash.
tickets.evidence: An updated funds-flow schedule is needed to separate gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Collect final capitalization table and option-cancellation records
tickets.text: Obtain the final capitalization table, option-cancellation records, and manager equity acknowledgments for Buttonwood Balloon Components to confirm Julian Maplesprocket's sale proceeds and retained obligations.
tickets.evidence: those equity ledger and option-cancellation records are needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare sale-liquidity staging plan
tickets.text: Prepare a plan showing how incoming business-sale cash for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket could be separated among immediate household reserves, estimated tax reserves, renovation funds, debt decisions, and staged investment tranches. Reflect Julian's preference for at least 18 months of household expenses in highly liquid accounts and regular household spending of approximately $22,000 per month.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-liquidity staging plan by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position
tickets.text: Assess position size, tax basis, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, trading restrictions, and diversification options before recommending any action. Review the proposed $1.5 million rollover of Julian Maplesprocket's sale proceeds into preferred equity of Copper Firefly Systems, covering liquidity limits, dividend terms, redemption rights, and concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that preferred-equity rollover review by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA sale-tax projection package
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated tax estimate for Julian Maplesprocket's sale of his 78% interest in Buttonwood Balloon Components, covering federal, Oregon, basis, installment-payment assumptions, escrow taxation, and shareholder note treatment. Coordinate with Alma Dewspindle at Silver Marmot Tax Partners.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model shareholder note payoff treatment
tickets.text: Model the $380,000 shareholder note payoff from Buttonwood Balloon Components separately from Julian Maplesprocket's equity sale proceeds so the advisory team and CPA can distinguish repayment cash from taxable sale consideration assumptions.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Clarify employee retention bonus pool variance
tickets.text: Clarify the difference between the figures for the employee retention bonus pool shown in the buyer's schedule and board materials, as the variance could affect net proceeds and working-capital adjustments for Julian Maplesprocket's sale.
tickets.evidence: Clarification of the retention bonus pool variance is needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare escrow holdback reserve analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a separate reserve scenario for Julian Maplesprocket's liquidity plan that excludes escrow release proceeds, reflecting that the $2.2 million escrow holdback may not be received in full for an extended period.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the escrow holdback reserve analysis by 2025-01-13.

tickets.title: Verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions
tickets.text: Verify Teacup Comet Bank's receiving-bank process and wire capacity for the expected business-sale proceeds before funds are sent, given Julian Maplesprocket's prior experience with a large inbound wire held for manual review.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Collect final consulting agreement economics
tickets.text: Obtain the final compensation, expense reimbursement, termination, and noncompete interaction terms for Julian Maplesprocket's post-closing consulting arrangement with Copper Firefly Systems to support the post-sale income forecast.
tickets.evidence: Final consulting agreement economics are needed by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Prepare post-sale investment policy
tickets.text: Prepare a written allocation framework for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket reflecting staged deployment, cash comfort, tax exposure, and fossil-fuel screening preferences after the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale converts much of Julian's net worth from private-company equity into liquid assets. Reflect Priya's preference for income reliability and Julian's preference to avoid investing the entire transaction liquidity immediately after closing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the post-sale investment policy by 2025-01-22.

tickets.title: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling
tickets.text: Model Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's possible Portland renovation ($900,000 to $1.2 million), existing mortgage terms (Portland residence $820,000 at 3.1%, lake cabin $310,000), and desired liquidity floor to determine how much sale cash can be committed to property spending.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling by 2025-01-16.

tickets.title: Review insurance transition after business sale
tickets.text: Review Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's insurance coverage after the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale, including changes in reliance on business income, company-owned insurance (key-person policy on Julian), disability coverage assumptions, umbrella exposure ($5 million personal umbrella), and potential personal-liability concerns after the transaction becomes public.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the insurance transition after the business sale by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Complete estate liquidity and fiduciary review
tickets.text: Review Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's 2016 estate planning documents in light of the anticipated liquidity increase from the business sale. Address fiduciary roles (Priya as primary, Oren Maplesprocket as successor), trust funding assumptions, privacy, and whether the plan still matches their current family circumstances.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review by 2025-01-17.

tickets.title: Prepare residency and sourcing support file
tickets.text: Prepare a residency and sourcing support file for Alma Dewspindle's sale-year tax analysis, documenting Julian Maplesprocket's 52 workdays outside Oregon during 2024, Oregon workdays, and Washington apartment records from transaction-related trips.
tickets.evidence: create a concrete need for a residency and sourcing support file for the CPA’s sale-year tax analysis by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding structure comparison
tickets.text: Compare charitable funding amounts and timing for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket using their usual $75,000 per year giving level, possible appreciated securities (including approximately $410,000 of low-basis Marzipan Meadow Automation shares), and potential business-sale liquidity. Address Julian's interest in a donor-advised structure or similar vehicle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the charitable funding structure comparison by 2025-01-14.
